{{Quote|Master Tanis, Commander Flybane, stay close.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Holocomm" />}}
'''Flybane''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Holocomm" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 24: Toydaria">{{FactFile2014|24|22 BBY 85-86|The Struggle for Toydaria}}</ref> Flybane aided [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tanis (Jedi)|Tanis]] during a [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. In the midst of the fight, Skywalker recorded a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] transmission, requesting aid from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], but he was spotted by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in the process. As Skywalker charged to attack the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], he told Flybane and Master Tanis to keep close.<ref name="Holocomm" /> Ultimately, the Republic won the battle.<ref name="RH">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Flybane received a brief mention in [http://www.lucasarts.com/games/jointheclonewars/holocomm.html?message_id=2&cam_requested=false holorecord made by Anakin Skywalker] that served as promotional material for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' and was posted on [[September 14]], [[2009]] on the [[LucasArts]] website.<ref name="Holocomm" /> However, Flybane did not appear in the game itself.<ref name="RH" />
